retainedHistoricalEvidence.note: The earlier failed negative-test fixture remains recorded.
37 passing tests preceded the held-warmup false-pass finding.
Historical review remains unmodified; this peer review binds only the final a3 sources.

historicalControlledProbes.significance: Intent journaling delayed actual sends past phase/deadline; arbitrary GuardError text reached public evidence.
A preparation claim did not validate the parsed independent review verdict or source bindings.
Holding every warmup intent until measurement caused a burst and no actual warmup, yet the prior check passed. This prior outcome remains a failed review probe.

resolvedFindings.problem: Phase assignment before evidence persistence allowed misclassification and sends beyond the timed window.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The synchronous actual transport-start hook rejects sends outside the reviewed window and classifies phase after evidence/provider queues. Actual send counts exclude blocked attempts.

resolvedFindings.problem: A provider GuardError could expose arbitrary detail as a public failure code.
resolvedFindings.resolution: A fixed public allowlist normalizes unknown GuardError and denial codes to PROVIDER_FAILURE.

resolvedFindings.problem: The live entry did not revalidate the canonical review and accepted mutable factory context.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Canonical review and source-bound plan are checked before provider access; copied nested execution context is frozen for factory and live entry.

resolvedFindings.problem: The hash-bound independent review's actual verdict and source scope were not cross-checked.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The parsed review must carry the required verdict and exact runtime/harness/plan/provider/operation bindings before private import.

resolvedFindings.problem: Scheduler lag omitted journal/provider queues, permitting zero actual warmup and a catch-up burst to pass.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Each actual transport start measures lag against scheduled due time and rejects unsupported capacity. The final gate requires rate-bounded actual warmup and exact samples/send counts.

reviewedBoundaries: 500 exact reviewed scopes: runtime, foreign and 498 load scopes; 1996 genuine business-actor sessions plus four genuine foreign sessions.

Session proofs require online Auth plus actual server session rows, unique session/connection IDs, expiry/revocation checks and genuine MFA for runtime roles, load-001 billing and two executor sessions.
Trusted worker connections use separately verified service-role authority; they do not acquire manufactured Auth session IDs.
Exact reviewed owner decision persists for the same bounded operation scope. Technical preparation binds the actual provider/plan without inventing another owner approval for unchanged operations.
Current installation, capacity and protected-provider fingerprints must be verified before execution and refreshed before load; installed SQL is not established by local fixtures.
Readiness precedes common barriers; actual transport intervals must overlap. Missing backend span evidence stays null.
All seven source-mapped contention cases require committed before/after effects and losing-attempt zero effects; uncertain mutations retain original identities and skip restoration.
The source-mapped lease claim commits one attempt/lease with zero usage reservations; authorization alone does not send a webhook.
Load uses 70/20/10, fixed 60s warmup/300s measurement, 900s total and 100000-request caps; p95 has strict reviewed limits. Actual Auth session population is distinct from peak simultaneous requests.
Model, webhook, operator and token/fake-Auth load are excluded. SQL row counts remain distinct from actual remote transport observation.
Unsupported excessive-source/group/output fixtures remain blocked and cannot claim an actual LIMIT_EXCEEDED rejection or exceed reviewed seed caps.
Public evidence uses fixed fields and safe error codes; private handles/tokens/raw responses and credentials stay outside it.
remainingLivePrerequisites: Implement and independently review the genuine private provider, dependency/transport implementation, private credential access and exact concrete fixture/restoration/query plan.
Verify actual installed contracts and capacity, genuine authenticated/MFA/session-row evidence, prepared populations and authoritative no-send observations.
Run actual barriers, committed effects and the full unshortened workload within the approved scope; report unavailable fixtures separately.
Authenticated native, actual delivery/model, full keyboard and owner acceptance remain separate evidence gates handled outside this local review.
